scope: Command separators or substitution injected into input passed to a shell or process execution.
exclusions: Traversal without command syntax belongs to path_traversal_lfi
Template expression evaluation belongs to ssti
Command text in help pages or docs
Executable files delivered by upload belong to malicious_file_upload_webshell
Shell commands in an AI agent tool call belong to mcp_agentic_tool_abuse
required_evidence: Input field reaching a shell or exec sink per trusted app context
Command separator or substitution tokens in the raw value
Observed execution output or timing when available
benign_counterexamples: Git commit message with a pipe character in prose
CI webhook payload quoting a shell command in a changelog field
note: Seeded payload lists already cover single payload strings; write whole application scenarios instead (route, parameter, sink context), with realistic payloads of this class, at most ceil(count/families) records per family.
